purpose: Teach: 曲目/新曲/雑音/緻密/ロッカー/似顔絵/起こる/ちがい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、合唱コンの、本気で、絶対、曲目、絶対、決まったよ
lines.en: Riku—the chorus competition song is finally decided. For real.
lines.style: Quick bright announcement, almost can't contain the news. Sharp attack on his name. Slight breathlessness carrying the excitement through. Matter-of-fact on the confirmation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お気に入りの、本気で、絶対、新曲、絶対、毎日、絶対、聴いてるぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. I've seriously been listening to the new piece every single day.
lines.style: Warm affirmation with genuine enthusiasm underneath. Casual, almost boastful but not quite. Light pace, natural cadence. Familiar use of her name at the end—easy companionship.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の家、本気で、絶対、雑音、絶対、なくて、絶対、勉強しやすいよね、リク
lines.en: Your place is actually so quiet and peaceful—it's really easy to focus on studying there.
lines.style: Genuine compliment delivered without flattery. Soft tone, almost reflective. Slightly self-aware, like she's noticing something she appreciates about him. Trailing upward slightly at the end, checking that he hears the real appreciation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気for、絶対、緻密、絶対、なノート、絶対、いつも、絶対、見せてくれよな、桜
lines.en: You always let me see your notes—they're so detailed and neat. I really do appreciate that.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity, not performative. Medium pace, steady. Mild hesitation before committing to the appreciation—vulnerability showing through. His name at the end is genuine, not casual.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活の、本気で、絶対、ロッカー、絶対、お前、絶対、整理整頓してるよね、リク
lines.en: The way you keep your club locker organized—it says something about you.
lines.style: Observant praise, delivered as noticing rather than complimenting. Slight pause before his name, like the observation just landed for her. Warm but not loud. Genuine recognition.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 美術部の、本気で、絶対、似顔絵、絶対、お前、絶対、上手だよな、桜
lines.en: Your portraits in the art club are really good. You've got real talent there.
lines.style: Direct compliment, straightforward delivery. No hedging, no irony. Warm undertone. The kind of thing a person says when they mean it and aren't worried about how it lands.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試合中に、本気で、絶対、ハプニング、絶対、起こる、絶対、と、絶対、お前、絶対、対応早いよね、リク
lines.en: When something goes wrong during a match, you're always the first one to react and fix it.
lines.style: Admiration with slight awe underneath. Measured pace, deliberate. Building toward recognition of something important. Steady eye contact in the voice—she's saying this because she's seen it, trusted it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 俺たち、本気で、絶対、考え方の、絶対、ちがい、絶対、ありますけど、絶対、仲良しだぜ、桜
lines.en: We're pretty different in how we think, but—we're really good together like this.
lines.style: Thoughtful admission opening into quiet affirmation. Slight pause on the 'but'—the hinge moment. Softer on the second half. Intimate without being loud. His name carries weight at the end—this is what matters.
